instruction: Masara ta tana kama da wani iri daban.
response: Akwai dalilai da yawa da za su iya jawo haka. Don taimaka min in gano ainihin matsalar, shin canjin launin yana farawa ne daga ganyen ƙasa ko sabbin ganyen dake sama? Kuma, an yi ruwan sama kamar da bakin kwarya kwanan nan a yankinku?

instruction: Don Allah awakin na suna ta tari tun shekaranjiya.
response: Bari mu ɗan nemi ƙarin bayani tukuna domin mu iya taimakawa awakin ku. Kusan dabbobi nawa ne abin ya shafa, kuma shin suna ci gaba da cin abinci yadda ya kamata? Sanin shekarun su da jinsin su zai kuma taimaka min wajen ba ku shawarar da ta dace.

instruction: Wane takin zamani ya kamata in yi amfani da shi?
response: Kafin in ba da shawarar komai, ina buƙatar ɗan ƙarin bayani game da gonar ku. Wane irin shuka da nau'in kuke shukawa, kuma a wane mataki na girma yake a halin yanzu? Idan kuma kun san irin ƙasar gonar ku ko tarihin takin da kuka yi amfani da shi a baya, hakan zai taimaka sosai.

instruction: Kajina sun daina cin abinci.
response: Akwai abubuwa da yawa da za su iya haifar da raguwar cin abinci ba zato ba tsammani. Kajin suna da makonni nawa, kuma wane irin abinci kuke ba su a yanzu? Haka kuma, don Allah ku sanar da ni idan kun lura da wasu alamun kamar faduwar fiffike, gudawa, ko wahalar numfashi.

instruction: Ina da masarar gauraya (hybrid maize) ta makonni uku a Zaria a kan ƙasar laushi. Na saka NPK 20:10:10 lokacin shuka. Menene shawarar jadawalin taki da adadin da ake buƙata a kowace hekta don top-dressing?
response: Tunda masarar ku tana makonni uku kuma kun riga kun saka NPK 20:10:10 a matsayin takin farko, mataki na gaba shine yin top-dressing da Urea (46% N) tsakanin mako na 4 zuwa na 5 bayan shuka. Saka kusan kilo 100 zuwa 120 a kowace hekta (kusan buhuna 2 zuwa 2.5) ta hanyar saka shi a gefe (side-placement) ko binne shi 5-10 cm nesa da gindin shukar don hana asarar sa ta iska (volatilization).

instruction: Ganyen suna komawa ruwan hoda-dudu (purple).
response: Ƙarin bayanai kaɗan za su taimaka min in gano ainihin ƙarancin sinadirai ko abin da ke haifar da matsalar. Wace shuka ce wannan, kuma shin ƙananan shukoki ne kawai abin ya shafa? Idan zai yiwu, don Allah a ɗauki hoto mai kyau na shukar baki ɗaya da kuma hoton ganyen da abin ya shafa.

instruction: Saniya ta ta kumbura.
response: Zan so in fahimci yanayin da kyau domin kumburi na iya nuna matsaloli daban-daban. A ina ne ainihin kumburin yake—shin yana kusa da muƙamuƙi, gefen hagu na ciki, ƙafafu, ko nononta? Haka kuma, yaushe ne ya fara, kuma tana tauna abincin ta (ruminating) yadda ya kamata?

instruction: Me yasa furen tumatir dina ke faɗuwa kafin su zama 'ya'ya?
response: Domin mu gano matsalar, shin yanayin zafi ya canza kwanan nan a yankin ku, musamman kwanaki masu zafi sosai ko darare masu zafi? Zan kuma so in sani idan ana ba su ruwa a kai a kai kuma idan kun saka takin mai ɗauke da sinadarin nitrogen da yawa kwanan nan.

instruction: Na fesa magani a gonar kabeji ta kwana 3 da suka wuce amma har yanzu ƙwayoyin (caterpillars) suna lalata su.
response: Bari mu duba wasu bayanan aikace-aikacen kafin yanke shawara kan mataki na gaba. Wane takamaiman maganin ƙwari ko sinadarin kuka yi amfani da shi, kuma wane lokaci a rana aka fesa shi? Haka kuma, shin alamun suna da muni a sabbin ganyen?

instruction: Rogo na baya girma da kyau.
response: Kafin in ba da shawara, ina buƙatar ɗan ƙarin bayani game da gonar ku. Wane irin rogo kuke shukawa, kuma yaushe aka shuka shi? Zai kuma taimaka in sani idan ana ci gaba da noma ƙasar ba tare da ba ta lokacin hutu (fallow period) ba ko saka takin gargajiya (organic matter).

instruction: Ina buƙatar taimako.
response: Sannu! Ni ne Homa, mataimakinku kan harkar noma daga Fallback AI. Domin mu fara, ko zaka iya sanar da ni idan kana aiki da shukoki ko dabbobi a yau, kuma wane ƙalubale kake ƙoƙarin warwarewa?

instruction: Wasu bishiyoyin barkono (peppers) suna mutuwa.
response: Wannan na iya faruwa sakamakon ruɓewar saiwa na fungal, bakitiriya, ko matsalar ba da ruwa. Shin wannan yana faruwa a wurin kiwon shukokin (nursery) ko a ainihin gonar ku? Idan zaka iya ɗora hotuna da yawa waɗanda suke nuna shukar gaba ɗaya, yanayin ganyen, da jikin itacen daidai layin ƙasa, hakan zai taimaka min gano matsalar da kyau.

instruction: Menene ma'aunin zafin da aka ba da shawara ga sababbin 'yan kajin (day-old broiler chicks) a makon farko a cikin ɗakin renonsu?
response: Ga sababbin 'yan kajin broiler (day-old broiler chicks) a lokacin makon su na farko, kula da yanayin zafi tsakanin 32°C da 33°C (90°F zuwa 92°F) a daidai matakin tsuntsayen. Lura da dabi'un 'yan kajin da kyau: idan sun taru a ƙarƙashin tushen zafi, yana nufin suna jin sanyi; idan sun matsa nesa sosai zuwa sasanninta kuma suna nishi dakyar, yana nufin zafin ya yi yawa. Rage yawan zafin da kusan 2°C a kowane mako mai zuwa har sai an kai matsakaicin zafin ɗakin.

instruction: Shin zan shuka dawa ta a yanzu?
response: Don ba ka cikakken bayanin yanayi da jagorar shuka, wace jiha da Ƙaramar Hukuma kake ciki? Ina kuma buƙatar in san wane irin dawa kake son shukawa, saboda lokutan girbewar da buƙatun ruwa sun bambanta.

instruction: A ina zan iya samun farashi mai kyau don sayar da waken soya (soybeans) da na girbe?
response: Don ba da shawarar kasuwa da ta dace don yankinku, wace jiha ko yanki kuke sayarwa a yanzu? Don Allah kuma ku sanar da ni ƙididdigar yawan da kuke da su (a cikin buhuna ko metric tons) da kuma ko an shanya hatsin da kyau kuma an wanke shi.

instruction: Me yasa kwan da kaji na ke sawa yake raguwa a cikin kejinsu?
response: Akwai abubuwa da yawa da za su iya haifar da raguwar yawan ƙwayen ba zato ba tsammani. Kajin suna da makonni nawa, kuma kun canza musu irin abincin su ko abubuwan dake cikinsa kwanan nan? Ƙari kan haka, don Allah a duba idan an sami wani tsaiko a cikin ruwan shan su na yau da kullun.

instruction: A Benue ne, suna da makonni 4 yanzu.
response: Na gode da wurin da cikakken bayanin shekarun. Domin in ba ka shawara da ta dace don gonar ka mai makonni 4 a Benue, wane irin shuka ko dabba muke tattaunawa, kuma wace irin matsala ko alamun cuta kuka lura da su?

instruction: Aladu biyu sun mutu da safiyar yau ba zato ba tsammani ba tare da rashin lafiya ba.
response: Wannan yanayi ne mai tsanani wanda ke buƙatar kulawa cikin gaggawa. Aladun suna da shekaru nawa, kuma kun lura da wani canjin launi zuwa ja ko ruwan hoda a kan kunnuwansu, cikinsu, ko fatarsu kafin ko bayan mutuwarsu? Don Allah a kuma raba idan an kawo sabon abinci ko baƙi zuwa ɗakinsu kwanan nan.

instruction: Shukokin koko (cocoa seedlings) suna komawa launin rawaya daga gefen ganyen.
response: Bari mu duba yanayin da ke kewaye da wurin reno (nursery). Inuwa nawa ne shukokin suke samu a halin yanzu, kuma ruwan na fita da kyau a cikin polybags ɗin bayan kun ba su ruwa ko bayan ruwan sama mai yawa? Sanin irin ƙasar da kuka yi amfani da ita zai kuma taimaka.

instruction: Ina son fara kiwon shanu na nama (cattle fattening), wane abinci ne mafi kyau?
response: Kiwon shanu da nasara ya dogara matuka kan dabbobinka da kuma abincin da ake samu a yankin. Wane jinsin saniya da kuma nauyin farawa kake hari? Haka kuma, gaya min waxanne ragowar masana'antu na gona—kamar dusa, dusar giya, ko hakin dabino (palm kernel cake)—ake samun sauƙin samu a yankinku.

instruction: Ruwa ya mamaye gonar shinkafa ta tsawon kwanaki 4 bayan ruwan sama mai ƙarfi.
response: Domin in duba yuwuwar farfadowar shinkafar, wane matakin girma ne amfanin gona yake lokacin da ambaliyar ta faru? Don Allah a sanar da ni idan ganyen shukokin da ke tsiro har yanzu suna sama da ruwan da kuma yadda sauri ruwan ke janyewa daga gonar a halin yanzu.

instruction: Ciyawa suna kwace gonar gyaɗa ta.
response: Bari mu ɗan nemi ƙarin bayani domin mu zaɓi hanyar kawar da ciyawa mai lafiya. Makonni nawa da suka wuce kuka shuka gyaɗar, kuma kun saka wani maganin kashe ciyawa na pre-emergence (kafin su fito) a lokacin shuka? Haka kuma, shin ciyayin da suka fi yawa na dogayen ganye ne ko faɗaɗa ganyen?

instruction: Lita nawa na ruwa ne saniyar mai shayarwa ke buƙata a rana akan matsakaici a cikin yanayi mai zafi (tropical climate)?
response: A cikin yanayi mai zafi, saniyar mai shayarwa yawanci takan buƙaci tsakanin lita 60 zuwa 100+ na tsaftataccen ruwa a rana, ya dogara da yawan nonon ta, yawan abincin da take ci, da kuma yanayin zafin waje. Shanun da ke ba da nono mai yawa lokacin zafi sosai suna iya shan fiye da haka, don haka yakamata a samar musu da ruwa koyaushe (24/7) a wuraren da ke da inuwa.

instruction: Kuraje farare sun fito akan ganyen kokumba na.
response: Wannan yana kama da zai iya zama powdery mildew, amma bari mu tabbatar kafin mu zaɓi magani. Shin tabo farare suna fitowa akan bangaren sama da ƙasa na ganyen, kuma yaushe kuka fara lura da wannan? Haka kuma, shin an shuka amfanin gonar a fili ne ko a cikin ɗakin noman zamani (greenhouse)?

instruction: Don Allah ganyen kuɓewa (okra) na suna fitar da ramuka da yawa.
response: Zan so in fahimci yanayin da kyau domin mu dakatar da lalacewar ganyen. Kun duba ƙarƙashin ganyen a safiyar wuri don neman ƙwari (beetles ko caterpillars)? Haka kuma, sanar da ni idan shukokin sun fara fure don mu zaɓi hanyar kawar da ƙwari wacce ba zata cutar da ƙwari masu amfani ba (beneficial pollinators).

instruction: Kifayen tarwada na (catfish) suna shawagi a saman ruwan kuma suna ƙoƙarin shan iska (gasping for air).
response: Domin mu taimaka wajen gano ainihin matsalar, wane irin kundi kuke amfani da shi—na ƙasa, kankare (concrete), ko tapalin (tarpaulin)? Haka kuma, sanar da ni yaushe kuka sauya ruwan kuma shin akwai wani wari mai wari da ke fitowa daga kundin.

instruction: Me yasa doyata ke ruɓewa a cikin rumbun ajiya (storage barn)?
response: Bari mu duba yanayin ajiya da tarihin girbi tukunna. Shin an busar da doyan yadda ya kamata a inuwa kafin a ɗaure su a rumbun, kuma kuna lura da ruba busashen ko mai taushi kuma mai wari? Idan zai yiwu, a ɗora hoto na doyan da abin ya shafa.

instruction: Menene matsakaicin lokacin ɗaukar ciki na 'yar awakin West African Dwarf goat?
response: Matsakaicin lokacin ɗaukar ciki don 'yar awakin West African Dwarf (WAD) kusan kwanaki 145 zuwa 152 ne, wanda yake kusan watanni 5. Domin sarrafa haihuwar da kyau, yana da kyau a shirya wurin haihuwa kusan mako guda kafin rana ta 145.

instruction: Don Allah wane sinadari zan fesa don kawar da ciyawa a gonar egusi ta?
response: Kafin mu zaɓi maganin ciyawa, ina buƙatar in sani idan ƙwayoyin egusi sun riga sun tsiro ko kuma kuna shirya ƙasar ne kafin shuka. Haka kuma, waɗanne irin ciyayi ne suka fi fitowa a wurin—shin masu faɗin ganye ne ko dogayen ciyawa?

instruction: Tunkiyata tana fama da gudawa mai tsanani kuma tana rage nauyi da sauri.
response: Wannan yayi kama da zai iya zama da alaƙa da ƙwayoyin cuta na ciki, canjin abinci, ko kamuwa da kwayoyin cutar bacterial. Yaushe aka ba dabbar maganin tsutsar ciki (dewormed), kuma kun fara ba ta wata sabuwar ciyawa ko ƙarin abinci a kwanan nan?

instruction: Na shuka ƴaƴan ayaba watanni 4 da suka gabata, amma ganyen suna komawa rawaya kuma suna bushewa daga saman su.
response: Wasu ƙarin bayanai zasu taimaka mana wajen samo asalin wannan. Shin ƙasarku tana riƙe ruwa sosai bayan ruwan sama, kuma kun bincika gindin ƴaƴan don ƙananan ramuka ko alamun ƙwari na ayaba (plantain weevils)?

instruction: Wane wata ne mafi kyau a shuka citta (ginger) a jihar Kaduna?
response: Don ba da cikakken lokaci don Kaduna, shin zaka dogara baki ɗaya akan ruwan sama na yanayi ko kana da na'urar ban ruwa da aka sanya a gonar ka? Sanin ainihin Ƙaramar Hukumarka zai kuma taimaka, saboda ruwan sama yana farawa a lokuta daban-daban a jihar.

instruction: Kananan talotalo na (turkey poults) suna ta mutuwa ɗaya bayan ɗaya a kowace rana.
response: Wannan yana buƙatar kulawa ta gaggawa. Menene ainihin shekarunsu a yanzu, kuma wane matsakaicin zafin kuke da shi a cikin ɗakin renonsu? Don Allah a kuma gaya min idan kun lura da bayan gida mai ɗauke da jini ko gudawa mai rawaya.

instruction: Ganyen shukokin kwaƙwa na (oil palm seedlings) suna da tabo-tabo masu launin ruwan ƙasa kuma masu zagaye da launin rawaya.
response: Bari mu duba yanayin wurin reno domin tabbatarwa ko wannan tabon ganye ne na fungal. Sau nawa kuke ba shukokin ruwa, kuma an jera su kusa da juna inda iska ba zata iya zagayawa da kyau ba?

instruction: Menene shawarar ƙimar shuka (seed rate) a kowace hekta don shuka irin wake (cowpea varieties) masu miƙewa (upright) a Najeriya?
response: Ga irin wake masu miƙewa da kansu a Najeriya, mizanin ƙimar shuka shine kilo 20 zuwa 25 a kowace hekta, tare da hange na samun shukoki kusan 250,000 zuwa 300,000 a kowace hekta ta hanyar amfani da sararin 50 cm tsakanin layuka da 20 cm tsakanin gindin kowace shuka.

instruction: Me yasa albasa ta baya fitar da kai mai kyau duk da cewa ta fitar da dogayen ganye?
response: Akwai dalilai da yawa da ke haifar da rashin fitar da kai da kyau. Shin kun saka takin nitrogen da yawa kwanan nan, ko kuma kuna shuka irin albasa da ke buƙatar hasken rana na awanni masu tsawo fiye da abin da yankinku ke da shi a halin yanzu?

instruction: Na ga kananan tsutsotsi da ramuka a cikin dankali na (sweet potatoes) da na girbe.
response: Wannan lalacewar ta nuna kwarin dankalin turawa (sweet potato weevils) ne. Watanni nawa bayan shuka kuka girbe dankalin, kuma kun lura da tsagewar ƙasa a kusa da gindin shukar lokacin rani kafin girbi?

instruction: Ƙwari suna cin bawon ƴaƴan riɗi (sesame plants) na.
response: Don taimakawa gano ainihin kwarin da ke haifar da wannan, wane launi da girma tsutsotsin ko kwarin ke da shi a jikin ƴaƴan? Hoton da kuka ɗora na ƙwari da kuma lalacewar bawon zai ba ni damar ba da shawarar matakin kawar da su mafi inganci.

instruction: Abarba na tana ɗaukar lokaci mai tsawo kafin ta yi fure kuma fidda ƴaƴan bai zo a lokaci guda ba (very uneven).
response: Bari mu duba shekarun da tsarin kulawa na gonar. Watanni nawa da suka gabata aka shuka ƴaƴan ko kawunan, kuma kun saka musu wani abin da zai saka su fitar da fure—kamar calcium carbide ko ethephon—don saka furen su bayyana a lokaci guda (synchronize flowering)?

instruction: Ruwan da ke cikin kundin kifaye na (earthen fish pond) ya koma koren duhu kuma yana wari mai muni.
response: Canjin launi da wari ba zato ba tsammani yawanci yakan nuna cewa datti ya yi yawa ko tsiron algal. Kilogram nawa na abinci kuke ba kifin a kullum, kuma kuna da hanyar fitar da ruwan ƙasa kuma ku saka sabon ruwa a yanzu haka?

instruction: Me yasa karas dina (carrots) suka fito gajeru kuma a naɗe-naɗe (twisted)?
response: Saiwa mai naɗewa ko gajarta yawanci yakan da alaƙa da yanayin ƙasa. Shin an noma gadon shukar da zurfi kuma an sassauta shi kafin shuka, ko ƙasar wurin tana da yawan yumbu da duwatsu (heavy with clay and stones)?

instruction: Aladai na masu tasowa suna cizon kunnuwa da jutsun juna.
response: Muna buƙatar duba yanayin ɗakinsu cikin gaggawa don dakatar da wannan tashin hankalin (aggression). Aladu nawa ne ake ajiyewa a ɗakin, menene matsakaicin nauyin su, kuma kun haɗa dabbobi daga ƴaƴan haihuwa daban-daban kwanan nan?

instruction: Akwai ɗigogi masu launin toka-fari masu gefen ruwan kasa (grey-white spots with brown borders) a saman ganyen shinkafa ta.
response: Wannan yana da alamun ciwon furen shinkafa (rice blast disease). Wane irin shinkafa kuke shukawa, kuma amfanin gonar na cikin lokacin tsironta ne (vegetative stage) ko gab da fidda ƴaƴa (heading stage)? Haka kuma, sanar da ni idan gonar tana karkashin ambaliyar ruwa ne gaba ɗaya ko kuna jiran ruwan sama ne kawai.

instruction: Kokumba da na girbe daga ɗakin greenhouse dina yana da ɗaci sosai.
response: Ɗacin kokumba yafi yawanci idan shukar ta fuskanci matsin yanayi (environmental stress). Shin shukokinku sun fuskanci ba su ruwa maras tsari kwanan nan, ko kuma zafin rana a cikin greenhouse ɗin ya yi yawa sosai?

instruction: Don Allah me yasa ganyen kabeji na yake ninka kansa tare kuma ya naɗe a ciki (curl inside)?
response: Bari mu bincika ganyen da kyau don gano abin da ke ɓoye a ciki. Shin kun buɗe naɗaɗɗun ganyen da hankali domin duba ƙananan kwarin aphids koren ko baki, ko kuma kun lura da wasu zare masu laushi na siliki (fine silky webs) da aka karkata a cikin ganyen na ciki?

instruction: Menene ma'aunin zafin jiki na al'ada na dubura (normal rectal temperature range) ga lafiyayyiyar tunkiya babba?
response: Ma'aunin zafin jiki na al'ada na dubura ga lafiyayyiyar tunkiya babba yana tsakanin 38.5°C da 39.5°C (101.3°F zuwa 103.1°F). Duk wani abu da ya zarce 40.0°C yawanci yana nuna zazzabi, tsananin zafi (heat stress), ko kuma wata cutar ta ciki.

instruction: Tumatir dina suna tsagewa kuma suna fashewa (cracking open) kafin su nuna gaba ɗaya.
response: Fashewar ƴaƴan itace yana da alaƙa da canje-canje na bazata a matakan danye. Shin gonarku ta fuskanci ruwan sama mai yawa ko kun yi ban ruwa (irrigation) nan take bayan wani lokaci na busasshiyar yanayi? Sanar da ni irin nau'in zai kuma taimaka, saboda wasu sun fi jure fashewa.

instruction: Uku daga cikin awakin da ke da ciki sun zubar da cikin su (aborted their fetuses) a wannan makon.
response: Wannan wata babbar matsalar lafiya ce ta garken da ke buƙatar kulawa a tsanake. Kusan watanni nawa awaken suke da ciki lokacin da zubar da cikin ya faru, kuma an kawo sababbin dabbobi cikin garken naku ba tare da an keɓe su ba (without quarantine)?

instruction: Yaushe ya kamata in sanya takin a gonar rogo na?
response: Don ba ka daidaitaccen lokaci da adadi, makonni nawa ko watanni da suka gabata aka shuka rogon? Zai kuma taimaka in san ko ana noman ne a sabon yankin da aka yanke daji (freshly cleared forest land) ko tsohuwar gona da aka daɗe ana noma ta akai-akai.

instruction: Broilers dina masu makonni 5 har yanzu suna kama da masu makonni 2.
response: Akwai 'yan wasu dalilai da zasu iya rage saurin girman su. Wane irin sunan kamfani da irin abincin musamman—kamar na farawa (starter) ko na gamawa (finisher)—suke ci a yanzu, kuma shin kun lura da taruwa guri ɗaya (huddling), karar motsin numfashi, ko kuma fari a hancin su (pale combs) a cikin garken?

instruction: Bishiyoyin gajiyata (cashew trees) suna zubar da ƴaƴan da basu nuna ba (immature nuts) kafin su girma sosai.
response: Wasu abubuwan muhalli guda ƴan kaɗan zasu iya janyo zubar ƴaƴan. Bishiyoyin suna da shekaru nawa, kuma kun lura da wasu baƙaƙen tabo na fungal (fungal spots) ko shatin cizon kwaro a jikin sabbin ƴaƴan da rassansu? Sanar da ni idan gonar ta fuskanci fari kwanan nan zai kuma taimaka.

instruction: Me yasa zomayena mata (rabbit does) basa samun ciki bayan an sadu dasu (mating) sau da yawa?
response: Don taimaka mana gano dalilin da yasa zomayenku mata basa ɗaukar ciki, menene shekarunsu da matsakaicin nauyinsu? Don Allah kuma a raba idan kuna haɗa su a lokutan safiya masu sanyi kuma idan an duba mazan don tabbatar da ƙarfinsu na saduwa (breeding vigor).

instruction: Ƴaƴan kifin tarwada na (Clarias fingerlings) sun fara mutuwa awanni 3 bayan na saka su a cikin tankina na siminti.
response: Tashin hankali na sufuri da zuba kifi (Transport and stocking stress) na iya zama da wuya sosai ga ƙananan kifi. Shin kun bar buhunan jigilar su yi iyo a cikin ruwan tankin na mintuna 15 zuwa 20 don daidaita zafin (equalize the temperature) kafin ku sake su? Haka kuma, sanar da ni matakin pH da tushen ruwan da ke cikin tankin ku.

instruction: Don Allah ganyen ugu na (ugu leaves) kawai suna komawa launin rawaya da fari.
response: Bari mu duba ganyen da kyau domin fahimtar abin da ke faruwa da ugu din ku. Shin launin rawaya da farin yana farawa ne daga tsofaffin ganye kusa da ƙasa ko kuma a kan sabbin ganyen da ke tsirowa? Hoto da aka ɗora wanda ke nuna saman da ƙasan ganyen zai taimaka min in gano kowane kwaro ko cutar fungal.

instruction: Menene lokacin hutun magani (withdrawal period) na allurar oxytetracycline a cikin shanun nama (meat cattle)?
response: Ga allurar oxytetracycline na dabbobi na yau da kullun (kamar nau'in 20% masu daɗewa suna aiki), lokacin hutu ga shanun nama yawanci kwanaki 28 ne bayan allurar ta ƙarshe a cikin tsoka (intramuscular administration). Kada a taɓa yanka dabbobi don amfanin ɗan adam a cikin wannan lokacin don tabbatar da ragowar maganin (antibiotic residues) suna ƙasa da matsakaicin adadin da aka amince.

instruction: Citta ta (ginger rhizomes) tana rubewa a ƙarƙashin ƙasa kafin in fara girbi.
response: Kafin yanke shawara kan tsarin magani, yaya yanayin malalar ruwa (drainage) yake a gonar ku bayan ruwan sama mai ƙarfi? Zan kuma so in sani idan kun ba da maganin kashe cututtukan fungal (protective fungicide) ga cittar ku kafin shuka.

instruction: Akwai wani farin ruwa kamar madara da ke fita daga idon saniyata na hagu kuma tana rufe shi.
response: Cutar idanu a shanu tana iya yaɗuwa da sauri idan ba a kula da ita da wuri ba. Shin kwayar idon kanta ta fara zama mai duhu ko shudi, kuma shin akwai wasu dabbobi a cikin garken da ke nuna irin wannan haushin ido? Haka kuma, don Allah sanar da ni idan wurin kiwon ku yana da dogayen, ganyaye masu ƙaya (tall, thorny brush).

instruction: Ganyen waken soya na (soybeans) suna da ƙananan tabo masu kaman tsatsa a ƙasansu.
response: Wannan kwatancen alamar cutar yayi kama sosai da Asian soybean rust. A wane matakin girma ne amfanin gonar ku a yanzu—yana yin fure ne (flowering) ko yana fara fitar da ƴaƴa (setting pods)? Sanin idan ganyen suna fara faɗuwa kafin lokaci (drop prematurely) zai taimaka min in ba da shawarar maganin fungal ɗin da ya dace.

instruction: Yaushe ne lokaci mafi kyau don ajiye kuma na siyar da busasshiyar masara ta a Kano?
response: Domin ba ku ingantaccen dabarun ajiya da tallace-tallace ga Kano, menene matakin ɗanshi na yanzu na amfanin gonar da kuka girbe, kuma wane irin wurin ajiya—kamar buhunan PICS (hermetic bags) ko silo mai samun iska da kyau—kuke da shi a yanzu?

instruction: Dodunan koɗo na (snails) sun rufe kokon su da wani farin fim mai ƙarfi kuma basa fitowa cin abinci.
response: Lokacin da dodunan koɗo suka rufe kokonsu da farin laima (whitish layer), hakan yakan nuna cewa sun shiga yanayin bacci ne saboda munanan yanayi (unfavorable conditions). Sau nawa kuke fesa musu sabon ruwa a ɗakinsu a yanzu, kuma menene matakin zafi da ɗanshi a cikin ɗakin dodunan kanku (snailery)?

instruction: Menene shawarar ratar shuka ga masarar gauraya wadda aka shuka ita kaɗai (sole-crop hybrid maize) a Najeriya?
response: Tabbataccen shawarar ratar shuka don noman masarar gauraya (sole-crop hybrid maize) a Najeriya shine 75 cm tsakanin layuka da 25 cm tsakanin ɗaidai a iri ɗaya a kowane rami (ko 75 cm ta 50 cm a iri biyu a kowane rami). Wannan tsarin yana haifar da kyakkyawan yawan shukoki wato kusan shukoki 53,333 a kowace hekta.

instruction: Ƙwayoyin audugata (cotton bolls) suna komawa baƙaƙe kuma basa buɗewa.
response: Bari mu duba yanayin oju-ọjọ (weather conditions) yayin matakin ƙirƙirar ƙwayar (boll-forming stage). Shin ruwan sama mai yawa ya faru yayin da ƙwayoyin suke nuna, ko kun lura da ƙananan ramuka da kwarin (caterpillars) ke cin ciki na ƙwayoyin?

instruction: Ƙananan agwagwa na masu kwanaki 10 basa iya tafiya da kyau kuma ƙafafunsu suna zamewa zuwa waje.
response: Matsalolin ƙafa a cikin ƙananan tsuntsayen ruwa sukan biyo baya ne daga yanayin ɗakin renonsu ko abincinsu. Shin kuna renonsu akan santsi, bene mai zamewa kamar jarida ko filastik maras kauri? Haka kuma, ku sanar da ni idan abincinsu yana ɗauke da wadataccen ƙarin sinadarin niacin (Vitamin B3).

instruction: Zangayen shinkafar tudu na (upland rice heads) suna tsaye tsaye kuma farare sol ba tare da kowane irin hatsi a ciki ba.
response: Farare, zangayen shinkafa marasa komai a ciki suna iya nuna harin kwaro (insect attack) ko damuwar da ba na kwaro ba (abiotic stress). Shin kun ga alamun mataccen zuciya (dead heart symptoms)—inda ganyen tsakiya suka mutu cikin sauƙi idan aka ja su—da wuri a kakar noman, ko gonarku ta fuskanci fari mai tsanani (severe drought) yayin fure?

instruction: Me yasa kajina suke kashi da jini (shit blood) tun da safe?
response: Bayangida mai jini a cikin kaji masu nama (broilers) ko na ƙwai (pullets) wata babbar alamar kashedi ce ta cutar coccidiosis. Kajinku suna da shekaru nawa, kuma shimfiɗar ɗakin tana da ɗanshi ko ta ƙeƙashe? Don Allah ku sanar da ni nan da nan idan kuna da wani maganin coccidiosis a hannu.

instruction: Kankana ta (watermelons) tana fashewa (splitting open) a jikin itacen ta kafin ta nuna gaba ɗaya.
response: Fashewar ƴaƴan itace yawanci yakan danganta ne da canje-canje na bazata a cikin ruwan da ke cikin shukar. Shin kwanan nan kun yi ban ruwa mai yawa ko kun sami ruwan sama mai yawa bayan wani lokaci na fari (prolonged dry spell)? Haka kuma, sanar da ni idan kun saka takin gargajiya mai yawan nitrogen lokacin girman ƴaƴan (fruit enlargement).

instruction: Kwai nawa ne mace-kifin tarwada (mature female African Catfish) mai girma ke fitarwa a kowane kilogram na nauyinta?
response: Mace-kifin tarwada mai girma (African Catfish - Clarias gariepinus) yawanci takan samar da kwai 40,000 zuwa 60,000 a kowane kilogram na nauyinta yayin kyankyasa ta wucin gadi (artificial breeding), matuƙar an kula da ita da kyau kuma tana ɗauke da cikakken ƙwai (fully gravid).

instruction: Wane maganin cutar fungal (fungicide) yafi kyau ga tomato blight?
response: Akwai magungunan fungal daban-daban dangane da ainihin nau'in blight da kuke fama da shi. Kuna ganin duwatsun da suke kamar ƙwayar ido (dark concentric target-like rings) akan tsofaffin ganye (Early Blight), ko kuma rawaya masu laushi waɗanda ke halaka ganye da rassan shuka cikin sauri (Late Blight)? Haka kuma, shin wannan shukar ana yinta a buɗaɗɗen gona ne ko a greenhouse?

instruction: Kudan zuma na (honeybees) sun bar gidansu na top-bar jiya.
response: Guduwar kudan zuma (Colony absconding) na iya faruwa saboda wasu ƴan dalilai daban-daban. Shin kun bincika kudan zuma ɗin (hive) kwanan nan don neman tururuwar sukari, ƙananan ƙwarin zuma, ko asu (wax moths)? Zai kuma taimaka in san idan wani ya fesa maganin kashe kwari (chemical insecticides) kusa da gidajen zumarku (apiary) a wannan makon.

instruction: Akwai wani ruwa mai danko (sticky sweet substance) a jikin ganyen dawa ta (sorghum leaves) kuma suna komawa baƙaƙe.
response: Wannan ruwa mai danko yayi kama da honeydew, wanda ƙwari masu tsotso (sucking insects) sukan fidda. Shin kun bincika ƙarƙashin ganyen dawa ɗin don neman tarin kwarin aphids? Idan zaku iya raba Ƙaramar Hukumarku (Local Government Area), zan iya duba ko an sami rahoton ɓullar kwarin aphid a kusa.

instruction: Na shuka doya (yam) tun mako 3 babu abinda ya tsiro (nothing don germinate).
response: Tsiron doya na iya ɗaukar ɗan lokaci kaɗan, amma bari mu tabbatar ko irin doyar suna da lafiya. Shin an shanya (cured) ko an yiwa irin doyar (yam setts) magani da tokar itace ko maganin fungal kafin a binne su, kuma shin ƙasar a bushe take (currently dry) ko kuma an rufe ta da kyau (well-mulched) don kiyaye ɗanshi?

instruction: Cikin rago na ya kumbura (bloated) kuma ya cika tamkar ganga bayan ya ci kwayoyin masara.
response: Cin kwayoyin hatsi da yawa na iya jawo acid na ciki da kumburi wanda zai iya zama barazana ga rayuwa (acute rumen acidosis and life-threatening bloat). Shin kumburin yafi yawa a gefen hagun cikinsa, kuma yana da wahalar numfashi? Don Allah a cire duk wasu hatsin nan take yayin da muke tantance adadin da ya ci.

instruction: Menene shawarar maganin ciyawa mai zaɓi (selective post-emergence herbicide active ingredient) bayan fitowar shuka don kula da ciyawa a gonar rogo?
response: Don zaɓaɓɓen ikon bayan fito (selective post-emergence control) ga ciyayi na shekara-shekara da masu dawwama a gonar rogo ba tare da lalata shuka ba, a yi amfani da maganin ciyawa mai ɗauke da sinadarin Fluazifop-p-butyl ko Haloxyfop-R-methyl. Ana amfani da shi lokacin da ciyawa ke girma sosai (actively growing) a matakin ganye 3 zuwa 5.

instruction: Bishiyoyin lemu na suna fidda ƴaƴa masu kauri sosai da kuma ɓawo maras ruwa (dry pulp inside).
response: Ƙananan citrus masu kauri da bushewa (Thick-skinned, dry citrus fruit) sukan faru akai-akai saboda rashin daidaituwar abinci mai gina jiki. Sau nawa kuke ba bishiyoyin taki, kuma kun taɓa saka musu takin phosphorus ko potassium? Haka kuma, don Allah sanar da ni kimanin shekarun bishiyoyin lemunku.

instruction: Ina son saka na'urar ban ruwa ta digo (drip irrigation) akan fili (plot) 1 na gona, wane ƙarfin injin (pump capacity) nake buƙata?
response: Daidaici injin ban ruwa ya dogara da ƙasarka ta musamman da kuma inda ruwan yake (specific terrain and water supply). Menene tushen ruwanku—kamar burtsatse (borehole), rijiya mara zurfi, ko buɗaɗɗen kogi—kuma mita nawa na bambancin tsayi ke tsakanin tushen ruwan da gonarku?

instruction: Ganyen ayabata suna tsagewa kamar zare (tearing into strips).
response: Domin mu rage idan wannan lalacewar iska ce ko wata cuta, a wace jiha kuke, kuma shin iska mai ƙarfi (strong winds) ta bugi gonarku kwanan nan? Haka kuma, shin ganyen na tsagewa kawai ne ko kuma suna komawa ruwan ƙasa da rawaya?

instruction: Aladai na suna tari (coughing) kuma basa girma yadda ya kamata.
response: Wannan na iya nuna wani cuta na numfashi ko tsutsotsi a ciki (internal parasites). Wane irin abinci kuke amfani dashi a yanzu, kuma menene shekarun aladun da lamarin ya shafa? Haka kuma, sanar da ni idan ɗakinsu yana da iskar da take shiga da fita yadda ya kamata (proper ventilation) da kuma wurin kwanciya mai bushe (dry bedding).

instruction: Menene shawarar adadin irin da za'a shuka (seed rate) a kowace hekta don shuka riɗi ta hanyar watsawa (broadcast) vs shuka a layuka (line planting)?
response: Ga shuka a layuka (line planting), shawarar adadin iri na riɗi ya kai kilo 3.5 zuwa 5 a kowace hekta tare da tazara 45–60 cm. Idan kuka zaɓi watsawa (broadcasting), zaku buƙaci ɗan ƙari—kusan kilo 5 zuwa 7 a kowace hekta—wanda aka haɗa da kyakkyawan yashi don tabbatar da rarraba yadda ya kamata (even distribution) a fadin gonar.

instruction: Don Allah ƙafafun talotalo na (turkey legs) suna lanƙwashewa kamar baka (bow leg).
response: Lanƙwashewar ƙafa a cikin talotalo sau da yawa yana da alaƙa da ƙarancin sinadirai ko ƙarin kiba mai sauri akan kashi masu rauni (rapid weight gain on weak bones). Menene shekarun poults ɗin, kuma wane abinci ko kari na bitamin (vitamin supplements) suke samu a yanzu? Sanin ko ana ajiyesu akan santsi, bene mai zamewa zai kuma taimaka.

instruction: Sau nawa zan dinga yiwa sabbin shukokin kankana ta (watermelon seedlings) ban ruwa?
response: Kafin bayar da shawarar jadawalin ban ruwa, ina buƙatar ɗan ƙarin bayani. Wane irin ƙasa kuke da shi—yashi ko yumbu (sandy or clay)—kuma yaya yanayin yanzu yake a yankinku? Haka kuma, kuna amfani da ban ruwan digo ne ko ban ruwan hannu (drip irrigation or manual watering)?

instruction: Kajina masu yin ƙwai (layers) suna saka ƙwai masu fushi, baƙar fata marasa ƙarfi (thin, weak shells).
response: Ƙwai masu fashewa zai iya samo asali ne daga ƙarancin sinadarin calcium, tsananin zafin zafin ɗaki, ko wata cuta. Makonni nawa ne kajin ku na masu yin ƙwai ke dashi, kuma wane irin ciyarwa kuke ba su ko ƙarin ma'adanai? Haka kuma, zafin rana a cikin gidan kaji yana da zafi sosai kwanan nan?

instruction: Bishiyoyin barkono dina (pepper plants) suna da tabo baƙaƙe a kan ganye kuma ƴaƴan suna ruɓewa a ƙasa (rotting at the bottom).
response: Wannan gamayyar na iya zama ciwon ƙarshen ruɓa (blossom end rot) ko ƙwayar cuta na fungal da ke yaɗuwa zuwa ga amfanin gonar. Idan zaku iya loda hoto mai tsabta wanda ya nuna ƙasan ƴaƴan da kuma ganyen da ya shafa, hakan zai taimaka matuƙa (help immensely). Haka kuma, jadawalin ban ruwan ku na yau da kullun ko ba na yau da kullun ba ne (consistent or irregular)?

instruction: Fall armyworm yana afkawa masarata (attacking my maize).
response: Bari mu tunkari wannan da gaggawa domin kare girbin ku. A wane mataki masarar ku ke a yanzu—mai tsayin gwiwa (knee-high) ko tana fure (tasseling)—kuma shin kun riga kun yi amfani da kowane fesa magunguna na sunadarai ko na halitta (chemical or biological sprays)? Sanin wurin da kuke zai kuma taimake ni in bincika matsalar kwari na yankin (check local pest pressures).

instruction: A wane shekaru ya kamata in bayar da maganin rigakafin cutar Newcastle (Lasota) ga garken kajina (broiler flock)?
response: Maganin cutar Newcastle na Lasota yawanci ana gudanar da shi ga broilers masu makonni 3 (kwanaki 21) ta hanyar ruwan sha, suna bin maganin rigakafin ido na farko Hitchner B1 wanda aka saba badawa a kwanaki 7 zuwa 10.

instruction: Zan iya ciyar da danyen bawon rogo ga tumakin na (feed cassava peels to my sheep)?
response: Eh, tumaki suna iya cin bawon rogo, amma bawon ɗanyen suna ɗauke da sinadarin cyanogenic glycosides wadanda zasu iya zama masu guba (can be toxic). Bawon suke danye, ko wadanda aka busar, ko wadanda aka yi musu magani (fermented)? Kafin a ciyar da su, bari in bayyana muhimman hanyoyin busarwa ko aiki (essential drying or processing steps) da ake buƙata don sanya su cikin koshin lafiya gaba ɗaya ga garken ku.

instruction: Kundin kifi na yana wari kamar ruɓaɓɓen ƙwai (smelling like rotten eggs).
response: Warin rubabben kwai yawanci yakan nuna cewa iskar gas ta hydrogen sulfide ta taru (hydrogen sulfide gas buildup) daga ruɓaɓɓen abincin da ba'a ci ba da kuma sharar gida a ƙasa. Wane irin kundi ne wannan—kasa ko kwankare—kuma yaushe kuka fitar da lakar kasa (flush out the bottom sediment) ko sauya ruwan?

instruction: A ina zan iya sayar da sabbin tumatur ɗina akan farashi mai kyau (fresh tomatoes at a good price)?
response: Don ba da shawarwarin kasuwa da ya dace (relevant market advisory), wace jiha da gari kuke sayarwa? Kuma, kimanin manyan kwanduna nawa kuke da su da suka shirya don girbi (approximately how many crates do you have ready for harvest), kuma zaku iya kwashe su zuwa kasuwannin birane na kusa ko kuna buƙatar masu siye su zo ƙofar gonar ku?

instruction: Don Allah ganyen rogona yana naɗewa tamkar lema (My cassava leaf dey curl up like umbrella).
response: Narkar da ganye a cikin rogo akai-akai yana faruwa saboda cutar Cassava Mosaic wanda Ƙwari (whiteflies) ke watsawa. Domin a tabbatar, shin ganyen ma yana nuna rawaya da koren rawaya (showing green and yellow mosaic patches)? Zai kuma taimaka in san wane irin nau'in rogon kuka shuka (which cassava variety you planted).

instruction: Menene shawarar zurfin shuka da jerawa don cittar rhizomes (planting depth and spacing for ginger rhizomes)?
response: Ya kamata a shuka ginger rhizomes a zurfin 5 zuwa 10 cm. Domin ratarwa, kafa ƴaƴan nau'in kusan 15 zuwa 20 cm a cikin jere ɗaya, tare da 30 zuwa 40 cm a tsakanin layuka (ko a kan hiro -ridges- masu tazara 75 cm tare da jeri biyu ga kowane hiro).

instruction: Awaki na mace ta haifi 'yan biyu (twins) kwanaki 2 da suka gabata kuma bata da nono.
response: Wannan yana da matuƙar muhimmanci ga lafiyar 'ya'yan. Shin jariran sababbi suna da rauni ko kuma suna yawan kuka ba kakkautawa, kuma kuna da damar samun nonon saniya, madarar canji (milk replacer), ko wata awaki mai shayarwa? Kuma duba idan ƙirjinta yana da zafi (hot), tauri, ko zafi lokacin da aka taɓa (painful when touched).

instruction: Ina so in shafa NPK a gonar ƴaƴan itacen dabino (apply NPK to my oil palm nursery).
response: Kafin saka taki, yaya shekarun sababbin shukokin naku ke cikin watanni, kuma suna cikin ƙananan polybags ne (small pre-nursery polybags) ko a cikin manyan jakunkuna na reno (main nursery bags)? Sanin ko kun yi amfani da haɗin gine-ginen ƙasa wanda ke da wadata (potting soil mixture rich in organic matter) a ciki zai kuma taimaka sanin adadin da yafi kyau.

instruction: Itaciyar mangwaro tana yin fure kowace shekara amma duk furanni suna faɗuwa (drop) kuma babu wani ƴaƴan da ke tsayawa.
response: Zubar da fure a cikin mangwaro na iya haifarwa da foda (powdery mildew), anthracnose, ko ƙwari mai yawa (heavy insect pressure) lokacin yin fure. Shin akwai farin ɗanɗano fari ko baƙon ɗimbin yawa a kan ganyen (fine white powder or black spot appear on the flower panicles)? Kuma, sanar da ni idan kuna wankewa ko watsa magani (spray the tree) a itaciyar yayin yin furanni.

instruction: Zomayena (rabbits) suna ci gaba da kankare kunnuwansu kuma akwai ɓawon da ya ɓarke a ciki (crusts inside).
response: Rɓar da ya karye a cikin kunnuwan zomo alama ce ta rashin lafiya ce ta kunnuwa (ear mites - Psoroptes cuniculi). Duk kunnuwan biyu sun shafa, kuma akwai wasu zomayen a cikin rumbun da ke kusa da sun fara karcewa (neighboring cages started scratching)? Idan zaku iya ɗaukar hoton cikin kunne, zai taimaka tabbatar (confirm).

instruction: Agwagwa na suna da idanu masu ruwa-ruwa (watery eyes) kuma suna girgiza kawunan su.
response: Numfashi ko idon cututtuka a cikin agwagwa zai iya ci gaba da sauri a cikin mawuyacin lokaci (damp pens). Kuna samar musu ruwa mai tsabta wanda yake isasshe a gare su su Nutsar da kansu (submerge their entire heads) don wanke idanun su? Har ila yau, gaya mani idan ka lura da wani sallama (nasal discharge) na hanci ko tashin hankali (wheezing).

instruction: Ganyen letus ɗin na dandanawa ƙwarai da gaske mai ɗaci (extremely bitter).
response: Ɗacin ɗanɗano na latas yana yawan faruwa a lokacin da shukar ta wuce lokacin zafi mai tsanani (heat stress) ko kuma ya fara fashewa/furewa (begins to bolt - flower). Menene yanayin zafi na yau da kullun akan gonarku kwanan nan, kuma mako nawa da suka wuce aka dasa letas ɗin (how many weeks ago was the lettuce transplanted)?

instruction: Menene bukatun da suka dace na Ɗanyen Furotin (CP requirement) ga kewayon Aladu (grower pigs) masu nauyin kilogiram 20 da kilogiram 50?
response: Masu shayar da aladu da nauyin kusan tsakanin 20 kg da 50 kg yawanci suna buƙatar ƙoshin abinci (require a balanced diet) da adadin kimanin 16% zuwa 18% Ɗanyen Furotin (Crude Protein - CP), kusa da wadataccen sinadarin lysine (kimanin 0.9-1.0%) da makamashin narkewa (digestible energy) don goyan baya ga saurin ci gaban ƙwayar jiki (rapid lean muscle growth).

instruction: Akwai wani abun da yake cin ramuka (eating holes) a cikin tubers dina ɗin (yam tubers) karkashin ƙasa.
response: Ramuka a cikin tuber yam ɗin cikin ƙasa (underground yam tubers) yawanci ana samar da su daga tsutsotsin ɗoya (yam beetles) ko kututturen nematode (root-knot nematodes). Shin ramukan manyan ramuka ne, ramuka masu zagaye (clean-cut, round cavities) ko ƙananan ramuka (small irregular pits) marasa tsari da masu kumburin saiwa (swollen roots)? Sanin inda kuke kuma ko gonarku kusa da kogi ne ko kwari (swampy areas) zai kuma taimaka.

instruction: Yaya zan gane cewa zuma ta a shirye take (ready to harvest) don tsinkewa daga kaho dina (hive)?
response: Domin ba ku shawarar mafi kyau, wane irin tarin bishiyoyi kuke sarrafawa - babban bar Hiva (Top Bar Hive) ko shingen Langstroth (Langstroth hive)? Haka kuma, shin kun buɗe shingen zuma din (opened the hive) don duba idan kumbar zuma tana rufe (capped) tare da ɗan fari wanda ke akwai 80% na abubuwan (thin layer of white wax over at least 80% of the cells)?

instruction: Shanu na suna da ƙananan kulli a ƙarƙashin fatar (small hard lumps under their skin) kuma masu ƙwari a ko'ina ƙafafunsu (ticks all over their legs).
response: Humps ɗin na fata zai iya nuna Cututtukan Fata (Lumpy Skin Disease), yayin da kasancewar mummunan bincike na kaska na buƙatar kulawa lafiya (heavy tick infestation needs safe treatment). Shin shanu suna gudu zazzaɓi (running a fever) ko matsananciyar tafiya? Da fatan za a sanar da ni idan kuna da damar zuwa na'urar fesa kaska (acaricide dip ko fesa) da kuma idan likitan dabbobi (veterinarian) na kusa.

instruction: Tumatir dina ɗin suna faɗowa a tushe (falling over at the stem base) kuma suna mutuwa a gaban ciyawa (dying in the seed tray).
response: Wannan yana da alamun damp-off, wata cuta ta fungal (fungal disease) a cikin noman gona. Shin kun ajiye tsaba a ƙarƙashin mai yawa a ciki (dense shade) ko kuna shayar dashi mai yawa zuwa yammaci (watering heavily late in the evening)? Sanin abin da kuka yi amfani da shi na ƙasa wajen yanka shukar zai kuma taimaka.
